limitations: This is a byte-identical immutable archive of the live canonical coverage immediately before the combined CGB helper and CgbSound promotion batch.
The snapshot proves only the frozen pre-promotion coverage identity; it does not classify any additional ROM bytes by itself.

Both independent artifacts in this batch must replay this same archive; after either promotion is accepted, this archive remains the baseline and does not replace the live post-promotion coverage file.

recovery.serialization: Canonical source bytes compressed with gzip -n -9; decompression is byte-identical to the source.
